title: Proposition B by precinct, with each precinct's estimated median household income, income group and place on the map
note: lon and lat are a point inside each precinct (its centroid, or a point inside the precinct when the centroid falls outside it).
method: select p.precinct, p.yes_votes, p.no_votes, p.yes_votes + p.no_votes as votes, p.yes_votes / (p.yes_votes + p.no_votes) as yes_share, p.median_income_est, f.fifth, p.lon, p.lat from prop_b p left join prop_b_fifths f using (precinct) where p.yes_votes + p.no_votes > 0 order by votes desc, p.precinct
